title: After the Kikuka Sho: A Father's Blessing

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer claims victory at the Kikuka Sho, leaving Mejiro McQueen shedding tears of frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing that, Mejiro Palmer questions whether or not she herself has that kind of passion for running.
